title: Bank Return Reasons and the Reason Charge on Home Purchase Financing Returned-Payment Fees
content:
**Return reason table — Home Purchase Financing**

Where the return reason is account closed or invalid account, the return reason charge is 5.00; where it is stop payment, the return reason charge is 10.00. On a return for insufficient funds no reason charge applies.

The return reason is the reason the bank gave on the newest return on the loan, the one being charged. The reason charge is added to the returned-payment fee — it is not multiplied by anything — and the fee is rounded half up to the cent once on the total.

| Return reason | Return reason charge (USD) |
|---|---|
| account closed | 5.00 |
| invalid account | 5.00 |
| stop payment | 10.00 |
| insufficient funds | none |

*Hypothetical cases.* A payment returned because the borrower stopped it carries a reason charge of 10.00; one returned because the account no longer exists carries 5.00; one returned for insufficient funds carries none.
